# Jjay Fabor

Jjay Fabor is a software engineer who builds full-stack products, backend systems, data workflows, and practical automation.

Portfolio: https://jjayfabor.com/
Projects: https://jjayfabor.com/projects

## Featured project

SecondTrip is callback and rework analytics for service teams. It analyzes service-job history, surfaces possible repeat visits with explainable deterministic signals, and keeps the manager's decision as ground truth. V1 uses no AI or LLM.

Case study: https://jjayfabor.com/projects/secondtrip
Live product: https://secondtrip.jjayfabor.com/

SecondTrip is a live private beta restricted to fictional or properly anonymized data. It is not approved for unrestricted production use with real customer data.
